text_block_list.text:
One day, a fan letter arrived for Meisho 
Doto—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
F-Fan mail? No way... F-For someone like 
me...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Could you have mistaken me for someone 
else? Because, well, I don't have any good 
qualities..."
choice_data_list: Why don't you try reading it first?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-You're right, I'll read it! Let's seeâ

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"I love seeing how hard you try"... "I'm a 
klutz too, so you gave me courage."

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm happy... It reminded me of my old 
self.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hearing in the post-race winner's 
interview that "even a hopeless person 
like me could change"—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I only came to this academy because I was 
given courage... Someone like me couldn't 
possibly...
choice_data_list:
So you're giving someone courage right 
now, huh.

So you're giving someone courage right 
now, aren't you.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... Trainer-san. I'll do my very, 
very best from now on.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"Even someone useless like me can give 
courage to someone else... I finally 
understand that now...!"

From that day on, Meisho Doto threw 
herself into her training with even 
greater dedication.
